Paychex Flex Enterprise: Enterprise Payroll and HR Software

See how Paychex Flex Enterprise, an enterprise payroll software and HR administration software solution, helps organizations manage complex workforce, compliance, and reporting needs on one platform. This video walks through how the enterprise payroll solution handles payroll processing, labor distribution, job costing, and custom analytics, plus discover how it supports performance management, onboarding, employee screening, compliance reporting, and financial wellness. Learn why businesses choose this payroll and HR software for its integrations, dedicated payroll specialists, and 24/7 U.S.-based support.

Topics:

  • 0:00 – Paychex Flex Enterprise Payroll Overview
  • 0:28 – Labor Distribution and Accrual Reporting
  • 0:58 – Custom Analytics and Tool Integrations
  • 1:40 – Performance Management and Document Control
  • 2:13 – Compliance Reporting and Employee Onboarding Tools
  • 2:39 – Learning and Financial Wellness Resources
  • 2:48 – Dedicated Support and Specialist Access

<p id="transcript-button">View Transcript</p>

Paychex Flex Enterprise Payroll Overview

0:04 Are you looking for a comprehensive HR and Payroll solution? Paychex Flex Enterprise offers the tools your company needs to succeed. To start, paying your employees has never been easier. You can submit your payroll online in as few as two clicks, and with our free mobile app, you can access all your Paychex information and submit payroll on the go.

Labor Distribution and Accrual Reporting

0:29 Allocate expenses like earnings, deductions and taxes to specific departments with labor distribution and use job costing to distribute expenses even further. Right down to a specific project. Once the payroll is processed, the allocations will flow to your general ledger. Set up your vacation and sick time policies with time off accrual reporting and ensure employees are getting the hours they've earned based on their years of service.

Custom Analytics and Tool Integrations

1:00 Our custom analytics and reports give you access to all the standard reports and analytics, plus the ability to create customized reports and data visualizations. So, you can share the information your team needs to drive better business outcomes. This powerful tool allows you to build your own reports from scratch and then sort, filter, and even add formulas, pivot tables, charts, and graphs. And with Paychex integrations, you can connect and share data between Paychex Flex and dozens of HR accounting point-of-sale and productivity tools, as well as third party vendors.

Performance Management and Document Control

1:41 With Paychex Flex HR Administration, you'll have access to even more solutions with a live report for each. Keep up on how employees are doing with performance management, check review dates, scores, and more all in one spot. The conversations feature allows you to look back on conversations in Paychex Flex within a specified time period. With document management, you can request forms and track expiration dates, share policies for signature or acknowledgement, and check which employees have completed their tasks.

Compliance and Employee Onboarding Tools

2:14 Track employee requests and get the information you need on job related injuries, including your OSHA forms with issues and incidents. And you can review employment and compensation data to help maintain a fair and equitable workplace. When it's time to hire, Paychex Flex Enterprise offers onboarding and employee screening tools.

Learning and Financial Wellness Resources

2:40 And we don't stop there. From learning management to employee financial wellness, give your employees the resources they need to succeed.

Dedicated Support and Specialist Access

2:49 Have questions? Your dedicated payroll specialist provides a single point of contact for all your payroll and tax needs. With 24/7 US based customer support, we're always ready to help by phone, email, or chat. For companies looking to simplify complex business needs, choose Paychex Flex Enterprise, your complete payroll and HR technology solution.

Simplify Payroll and HR Administration

Manage payroll, reporting, compliance, onboarding, employee performance, and workforce administration from a single connected platform. Paychex Flex Enterprise helps organizations streamline operations while supporting growth and employee success.

Explore Paychex Flex Enterprise
